notes: Zero @keyframes, zero CSS animation rules, zero IntersectionObservers, zero scroll/mousemove listeners, zero rAF in a full scroll pass — the site is static. `motion.scroll_effects` in the raw profile listed two 'pin (fixed)' entries (div.overlay, a category section); both are the resting `position: fixed` drawer scrim and the app shell's absolutely-positioned chrome, not scroll-driven effects, so `scroll_effects` is empty here. Colors are taken from the site's own 33 custom properties (--color-green #336633, --color-charcoal #333333, --color-darkgrey #666666, --color-mediumgrey #999999, --color-ultralightgrey #eeeeee, --color-yellow #fed700, --color-blue #006699, --color-hovertilegreen #edf2ed, --color-hovergreen #3c773c, --color-activegreen #2b552b, --color-hoveryellow #ffffb5), corroborated against computed styles. `space.base` is 5px, not 8px: 692 elements use 5px inline padding — the real rhythm is the 72×114px catalog cell, recorded under `space.cell`. Line-height is inverted vs. convention (1.15 at 10.5px, 1.3 at 12px) so two-line labels fit the clipped cell. No `color.dark` block: `craft.theme.supportsDark` is false, `meta.color_scheme` is `normal`, and no dark re-theme exists — the profile's `theme.dark` sample is just the light page re-read. No responsive tokens/breakpoints: `<meta viewport content="width=1024">`, zero media queries, mobile capture identical to desktop. Type sizes kept in px (the site never uses rem for layout type); 0.75rem/0.875rem appear only in the button and utility-copy rules and equal 12px/14px.
